minutes.headline: Finance Committee backed the FY25 budget 5-1 but deferred its vote on the school override one week.
minutes.summary: At a long public hearing on the annual town meeting warrant, the committee heard the Personnel Committee, the planning board and the town manager's budget presentation. It then voted recommendations article by article, ending near 11:39 p.m. The override article was deferred a week over the added school maintenance money, and the two exemption articles were deferred.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted 5-1-1 to recommend the FY25 omnibus budget article to town meeting.
The committee deferred its vote on the school override article one week, 5-2, with the override vote to follow the select board's next meeting.
The capital plan article was recommended 6-1, and the two exemption articles were deferred to town meeting.
Sewer, solid waste and water enterprise articles were each recommended 7-0, and most other articles passed unanimously.
The April 1 meeting was canceled, the next is April 4, and the cemetery commission is to be invited to a future meeting.

why_it_matters: The school override, which would raise property taxes above the levy limit if town meeting and voters approve it, still has no Finance Committee recommendation.
The budget the committee recommended added levy, ARPA and local receipts to the school line to close a gap, so how much of the override covers one-time money was still being asked about by residents.
watch_next: The Finance Committee's override vote, set for its next meeting on April 4 after the select board meets.
The town meeting warrant articles on the override and the two deferred exemption articles.
